notes.title: The sequel is coming!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all members of this humble community for being with me. I am grateful for all comments and constructive criticism.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622083/f34bf8fe28e9911fff2a623dd30bf0cc085ac3bc.png[/img]
I wanted to let you know that I'm currently working on a continuation of Seth's adventures. I have read each of your comments here and on social media and tried to draw conclusions. In the new version, I abandoned tank control in favor of an isometric projection. I added a melee combat system and expanded the FPS mode system with several types of weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622083/693e623ce6fc9b1bf60655a6b2394b1586d5623c.png[/img]

notes.title: Psychological detective, survival horror, inspired by Lovecraft
notes.notes:
Welcome to a dystopian world ruled by Novi Mundi Lucius Corporation (NML).
In our reality, the corporation enacts laws that aim to transfer wealth from the bottom up and polarize society.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622083/ddff3f4ae9d7e01559edaae52a6d8bb8d047786c.png[/img]

Human cloning, castration, eugenics, prohibition of religious rites, and in all this you - Seth Vidius, an investigator, working for the Ministry of Law Enforcement NML.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622083/350ba78be903007e8b14633f757d3b0c64d89fda.png[/img]

You are currently investigating a death near a mine in the town of Happy Rock.
The task, as you can see, is not easy, because in this place there are more opponents than supporters of corporations.
Fortunately, you are a fearless hero who can handle (I hope) any case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622083/49fee93132f1a4e0a47e8959c133222daf883fef.png[/img]

In order not to spoil, I will only say that in "The Order of the Snake Scale" there is a lot of action, puzzles, connecting facts, collecting evidence, interviewing witnesses and exploration.
Mystery, dark noir style, inspired by Lovecraft and an extraordinary plot set in its own Universe.

All this creates the atmosphere of a unique game that I hope you will remember.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622083/78ef5bccb05d25b386306c9b7323ca775b98d29d.png[/img]

If you are interested in our game, follow us on Steam,
or on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/98Z8v3ABJ9

Have a great day!
